items.t: How would you have paced the first few seasons of wot if you were in charge? I used to sort of think: season 1, eotw + partway through great hunt, at least as far as the horn getting stolen, that way if horn had been set up properly it will feel like a huge cliffhanger and also we get to expand the world a bit by introducing the aes sedai at the end season 2: great hunt + dragon reborn. I don’t know how they could have fit this all in other than that my basic thought is cut where we can, for the sake of preserving the stories as they are in the book and adapting to screen, add absolutely no random stuff like Steppin or Dana the Dumpy Darkfriend because fitting it all onto tv is already enough of an undertaking (I’m like, one of 5 people on this Earth who thinks there is no such thing as the slog though, so I would be terrible at making these decisions myself) – this is the season when the super girls are in the tower, the season when Rand has his reckoning with whether or not he is the DR and comes out at the end KNOWING it. season 3: book 4 content? I feel like we need to get to Rand as The Dragon Reborn by season 3, as opposed to by season 4, but that it was a huge mistake cutting out all of the magnificent content in Tear. Felt totally wrong. I’m not really sure where to go from there. I sense that books 5 & 6 could somehow be condensed into a season even if I also feel like a madwoman saying that. anyway, interested to hear how you would organize the seasons by books and perhaps what you would cut in order to make it all fit
